brief: GS's desk note frames the regime first: index vols stay low versus history even as SPX notches record highs, skew is crushed into the front end, and dealer long gamma is dampening realized moves, a low-vol backdrop that coincides with rising dispersion between AI leaders and rate-sensitive laggards. That dispersion is the engine of 2026's dispersion trade: implied correlation sits near historical lows while realized correlation falls further as single-stock earnings (AMZN, MSFT, NVDA) keep beating implied pricing, so the SPX top-50-vs-index vol spread has cratered from July highs, and some clients are now buying single-stock vol and selling index vol to defend the trade after months of the opposite flow. GS also flags early signs of a breadth recovery (SPX vs ex-AI SPXXAI). Separately, GS pitches tactical longs in nuclear/AI-power names (Uranium basket, URA) on accelerating buildout headlines, a constructive setup into semis earnings (AMAT, CDNS) and SPCX's reiterated Buy, record-short VIX futures positioning that leaves vol vulnerable to a squeeze (GS rolled a client's hedge further out to November), a record EWZ inflow on Brazil's election rally with a tactical put hedge, and a bullish CSI 300 AI-hardware swap idea.
